extension.description: Run the opencode v2 TUI inside VS Code and inject the current file or selection as an @path#Lx-Ly reference
dialog.diagnostics: Add problems from this file to opencode
dialog.selectDiagnostics: Select the errors / warnings to include
dialog.draftHelp: Confirm to add this draft to the existing terminal. Press Enter in OpenCode when ready to send.
message.noDiagnostics: This file has no errors or warnings reported by VS Code.
message.invalidDraft: Enter a non-empty, single-line prompt without terminal control characters.
prompt.diagnostics: Explain the causes of these problems and suggest fixes:
message.noTerminal: No opencode terminal is open. Run Open opencode and wait for the TUI to be ready first.
message.terminalClosed: The selected opencode terminal was closed. Nothing was added.
message.noFile: No file is open, the file is outside the workspace, or its path contains control characters.
message.invalidFiles: Select only existing files inside the workspace, with no control characters in their paths. Nothing was added.
config.binary: Command used to launch the TUI. Accepts a full path or flags, for example opencode --standalone
config.terminalName: Terminal name used to decide whether to reuse an existing session. Keeping the default lets it reuse a terminal you opened yourself
config.injectOnLaunch: Also inject the current file reference when creating a new terminal. Off by default: characters sent before the TUI takes over input can be executed by the shell
